svg.title: Awaken: aligned audio and token streams
svg.desc: Recorded excerpt from example 01-s0: user and assistant waveform envelopes above aligned text controls and five stacked speech-code slots. The backchannel oh no is followed by SIL, EOS, and idle PAD.

g.text: Awaken: aligned audio and token streams
Recorded backchannel excerpt · shared waveform, text, and speech-code alignment
Each column is 200 ms; its five audio-code slots are generated in sequence at 25 Hz.
PAD: listening / idle · SIL: voicing tail · BOS: speech start · EOS: speech release
Source: alignment example 01-s0, 3.6–5.6 s. Prefix is schematic; tokens and waveform envelopes are recorded.
